caveats: This cockpit shows the full denominator (every hypothesis and row), not winners only.
All real-traffic evidence is dry-run / package-local and non-canonical; nothing here is crossed, candidate-registered, paper-ready, or live-ready.
Positive PnL surfaces that fail the primary drawdown screen are shown as non-promoting, not as edges.
Withheld statistics (Monte-Carlo / bootstrap / PSR / DSR / MinTRL) are labelled explicitly rather than fabricated.
Display ordering is deterministic and confers no ranking, recommendation, readiness, or promotion authority.
Any real transition, candidate admission, crossing, or approval requires separate human action; this cockpit cannot grant it.

hypotheses.economic_rationale: A strong no-wick candle that closes on the trend side of EMA50 and retests the EMA may indicate continuation after directional impulse rather than mean reversion.
hypotheses.go_definition: All denominator rows are preserved, population-level net performance and drawdown pass the frozen screen, cost burden is not dominant under available metrics, and sensitivity is not winner-only; GO-like evidence still requires human decision and creates no admission or crossing authority.
hypotheses.name: BTCUSDT 4h no-wick EMA retest continuation
hypotheses.reading: NO-GO / not candidate-worthy despite positive median return because max drawdown is about 77.1% and sensitivity includes negative rows.

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Breakouts accompanied by abnormal participation and an ATR-normalized candle range may reflect real order-flow participation rather than thin-channel noise. This tests participation-confirmed continuation, not Donchian, ORB, or Bollinger squeeze behavior.
hypotheses.go_definition: All denominator rows are preserved; median net return is positive; at least 5/8 rows are positive; drawdown remains below the frozen screen; costs are measured honestly; favorable evidence spans more than one RVOL and range threshold.
hypotheses.name: BTCUSDT 15m RVOL-gated range-expansion breakout
hypotheses.reading: RVOL-gated immediately previous-bar high/low range-expansion breakout; not Donchian, not ORB, not session-anchor substitution. Positive PnL rows are offset by drawdown around 77.28%, so the frozen GO screen is not met.

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Rolling candle-VWAP approximates recent volume-weighted fair value from OHLCV. A large ATR-normalized distance from that anchor plus RSI exhaustion may represent a liquidity overshoot that can revert without relying on SMA/stddev bands.
hypotheses.go_definition: All denominator rows are preserved; median net return is positive; at least 5/8 rows are positive; drawdown remains below the frozen screen; cost/churn is not dominant; favorable evidence is not isolated to one VWAP lookback or RSI threshold.
